snippet.title: "Legacy Code" 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
"Legacy Code"
Steam Store Page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354380

In the world of “Legacy Code,” you become a mysterious creature known as a Mechanimal and set out on a journey to discover your true self. Defeat other Mechanimals to gain experience, collect parts, and modify your body to grow stronger and larger. The types of parts range from biological materials to inorganic objects! Build your own ultimate Mechanimal and complete your story.

－－－－－－－－－－
